reason: A pre-online source audit showed that Transformers 4.46.2 suppresses both scheduler and RNG serialization when save_only_model=true. Model-only resume therefore preserved weights and global_step but silently restarted the linear learning-rate schedule and did not restore the seed-42 sampling stream. Adam moments were already intentionally omitted to avoid the measured host-RAM serialization failure.

details: atomically save and restore the small scheduler state and synchronize the fresh optimizer to the restored current learning rate
atomically save the Trainer RNG state so resumed rollout sampling continues the seeded stream
write a completion manifest that explicitly records the unavoidable Adam-moment reset
retain two model-only checkpoints so an interrupted serialization cannot erase the previous certified resume point
resume only from checkpoints whose model, trainer state, scheduler, RNG, and lightweight completion manifest agree on global_step
retain two model-only checkpoints for crash-safe rotation

scope: Pre-outcome operational resume correction. It cannot change a selection rollout, reward, model update before an interruption, evaluation prediction, or statistical decision. It preserves the originally intended scheduler position and seeded RNG stream after interruption; Adam moments remain explicitly reset because full optimizer serialization is the measured OOM failure mode.
